title: Fungal factories for feeding the future: mycoproteins as a sustainable protein source at the interface of food, health, and biotechnology innovation
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00914F, Review Article

Cristina Firincă, Mariana Constantin, Iuliana Răut, Lucian-Gabriel Zamfir, Maria-Luiza Jecu, Mihaela Doni, Ana-Maria Gurban
Mycoproteins represent a relevant option for future food systems. This review integrates recent advances in production technologies, nutrition, safety, and environmental impact, while highlighting current challenges and research opportunities.
